title: Agent Output Contract Schema
description: Defines the required structure for an agent's output contract. Each agent defines its contract in minimal-report.yaml using this schema.

required_sections.description: Markdown headings that must appear in the agent's report

optional_sections.description: Markdown headings that may appear if applicable

required_fields.description: Fields that must be present (e.g. decision, risk level)

severity_classification.description: Whether findings must include severity levels

forbidden_patterns.description: Regex patterns that must NOT appear in the report

required_patterns.description: Regex patterns that MUST appear in the report
